scope: H3 internal inference ablation, quality only; not a reproduction of GenBench or of LiveAvatar training.
sampling: One raw full frame at each integer second, 0 through 179, identical across arms.

IQA.preprocess: Official score(): mean-color square padding and bundled 448-pixel CLIPImageProcessor.
IQA.precision: FP16 model; FP32 softmax of the five returned logits with weights [5,4,3,2,1].

ASE.preprocess: Same official image scoring preprocessing as IQA.

Dino-S.feature: L2-normalized final CLS embedding; cosine similarity to the original user-provided reference.
Dino-S.preprocess: Bundled Hugging Face image processor; same resize and center crop for generated frames and reference.
Dino-S.limitation: Appearance similarity is affected by pose, background and the center crop; not a biometric identity test. LiveAvatar does not specify the exact DINOv2 variant and preprocessing in the cited metric paragraph.

T.Flicker.frames: All 4320 original-resolution frames in [0,180) at 24 fps, including generation boundaries.
T.Flicker.primary_scope: nora_idle only; motion depresses this score, so motion scenes are not ranked by it.

aggregation: Average samples within each trajectory first. Aggregate only scene/seed groups where all seven arms have complete metric outputs. Show mean and sample standard deviation across these paired groups, plus paired deltas; frames are not independent experimental replicates.
no_claims: No direct numerical comparison with paper scores: dataset, duration, resolution, model and some evaluator details differ.
No human MOS scores have been collected.
No FID/FVD: no corresponding ground-truth video distribution in this study.
No overall winner inferred from a single metric.

focused_analysis.design: Post-hoc selection of every complete baseline/anchor pair within the first 1636 request records; no new generation.
focused_analysis.intervention: After the common opening, replace both DiT image-reference latent blocks with the first generated latent; keep it fixed. Original multimodal embeddings remain unchanged.
focused_analysis.scope: H3 inference adaptation of AAS, not causal sink-KV architecture or a full paper reproduction.
focused_analysis.reference_for_dino: Original input image in both arms.
focused_analysis.rope: Existing window positions unchanged in both arms; no global-fixed/global-follow intervention.
